excerpts.text: General Synthesis of 2D Magnetic Transition Metal Dihalides via Trihalide Reduction. A chemical-vapor-deposition route produced high-quality 2D transition-metal dihalide flakes including VCl2 by reduction of trihalide counterparts.

Oxygen-Assisted Growth of 2D Vanadium Oxyhalides with Ordered Vanadium Dimerization. An oxygen-assisted CVD method selectively synthesized vanadium dichloride (VCl2) and VOCl with phase control and high crystallinity.
